def max_area(grid):
    if not grid: return 0
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = [[False]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    max_a = 0
    
    def dfs(r, c):
        if r < 0 or r >= rows or c < 0 or c >= cols or grid[r][c] == 0 or visited[r][c]:
            return 0
        visited[r][c] = True
        area = 1
        area += dfs(r+1, c)
        area += dfs(r-1, c)
        area += dfs(r, c+1)
        area += dfs(r, c-1)
        return area

    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == 1 and not visited[r][c]:
                area = dfs(r, c)
                max_a = max(max_a, area)
    return max_a

def max_area(grid):
    if not grid: return 0
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = [[False]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    max_a = 0
    
    def dfs(r, c):
        if r < 0 or r >= rows or c < 0 or c >= cols or grid[r][c] == 0 or visited[r][c]:
            return 0
        visited[r][c] = True
        area = 1
        area += dfs(r+1, c)
        area += dfs(r-1, c)
        area += dfs(r, c+1)
        area += dfs(r, c-1)
        return area

    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == 1 and not visited[r][c]:
                area = dfs(r, c)
                max_a = max(max_a, area)
    return max_a
